thread:
DanL: Quick heads-up — planning a lift-and-shift patch for search-indexer into eu-west-1 tomorrow 10:30 PT. Expected ~20m. Need a smoke owner + rollback readiness. Any blockers?
BenM: Which service image/tag are we moving?
DanL: tag = v2026.03.17-patchA. No DB schema changes, just model weights + env tweak.
Alice H: I can take smoke ownership. Will run the canary and sanity checks.
Cara: Are we touching the feature flag? last time that affected response shaping.
DanL: No feature flags touch. Just weights + MAX_LEN env from 1024 -> 1536.
Erin: I'll prep rollback steps and watch metrics during canary. What are SLOs for this patch?
DanL: Main checks: 95th latency < 400ms, error rate < 0.5%, embedding similarity regression < 1.5% on the smoke set.
Alice H: noted. I'll run the smoke harness and sample the embedding QA set.
BenM: Which routing policy for the canary? region-only or cost-tier fallback?
DanL: region-only canary (eu-west-1 traffic split). If metrics fail, immediate rollback to v2026.03.15-stable.
Erin: Rollback command pinned: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/search-indexer search-indexer=redwood/search-indexer:v2026.03.15-stable`
Erin: And rollback verification: `curl -sS https://canary-eu-west-1.api.redwood.internal/health | jq .` expect status.ok true and model_version == "v2026.03.15"
deploy-bot: :information_source: Scheduled: search-indexer canary for 2026-03-17T10:30:00-07:00 in eu-west-1. Reminder +15m.
Alice H: Claiming the 10:30 slot in the calendar. I'll post results in this thread.
Cara: Quick preflight — please confirm CI image build id and sha so I can cross-check logs.
DanL: Build id: build-4821, sha: 9f3c2a7.
BenM: I pushed a tiny runbook snippet to the repo: docs/deploys/search-indexer-handoff.md (added canary checks + rollback cmds).
Alice H: Preflight done: canary plan uploaded to the ticket, smoke checklist passed on dry-run.
Erin: I'll wire alerting: set a short-lived alert on error-rate crossing 0.5% and a pager if latency > 600ms for 2m.
DanL: Perfect. If smoke passes, we do gradual ramp 10% -> 30% -> 100% (5m waits) unless flagged.
Alice H: If anything looks off, I'll call for immediate rollback and ping @oncall.
BenM: FYI I'll be available for rollback handover until 11:15 PT.
Erin: All set on my side. Will attach the smoke logs to the ticket after run.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary completed (10:37 PT). 10% -> passed checks.
Alice H: Canary results: latency p95 = 370ms, errors 0.2%, embedding drift 0.9% on smoke set. Green. Ramping to 30%.
DanL: Thanks all — continue ramping. Will monitor for 30m post 100% before closing.
Alice H: Closing notes will be posted here once the 30m observation window is done.
Erin: Logged rollback artifact: tag `rollback/v2026.03.17-patchA-prev` for quick revert if needed.
Alice H: Observation window complete. No regressions. Marking this done and updating the release diary. :tada:
DanL: Awesome work, team — thanks for the quick coordination.
